items.name: All Settings Explorer: Scan and Build Live Catalog
items.description: Runs a dynamic machine scan from powercfg /qh SCHEME_CURRENT + /aliases + /query and populates Falcon's interactive explorer.

steps.command: Write-Output 'Use the All Settings Explorer tab UI scan button for dynamic enumeration and filtering.'

items.name: All Settings Explorer: Export raw /qh
items.description: Readback helper. Exports raw powercfg /qh for parser verification.

steps.command: $ts=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $dir=Join-Path $PWD 'logs'; if(!(Test-Path $dir)){New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir|Out-Null}; powercfg /qh SCHEME_CURRENT | Out-File -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $dir ('powercfg-qh-'+$ts+'.txt')); Write-Output 'Raw /qh exported.'

items.name: All Settings Explorer: Export raw aliases + query
items.description: Readback helper. Exports aliases and query raw output to support GUID/alias validation.

steps.command: $ts=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $dir=Join-Path $PWD 'logs'; if(!(Test-Path $dir)){New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir|Out-Null}; powercfg /aliases | Out-File -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $dir ('powercfg-aliases-'+$ts+'.txt')); powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT | Out-File -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $dir ('powercfg-query-current-'+$ts+'.txt')); Write-Output 'Raw aliases/query exported.'

items.name: All Settings Explorer: Verify common AC/DC readback
items.description: Diagnostic readback for common processor/video/sleep settings after writes.
